**Subject: Application for Test Lead**

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Test Lead opportunity with Hydrogen Group, supporting a strategic digital platform implementation within the financial services sector. With over 19 years of software testing experience encompassing QA leadership, complex payment and cloud platform delivery, and end-to-end quality governance, I offer the hands-on technical depth and cross-functional leadership required to drive solution quality and go-live readiness.

In my recent roles, I have repeatedly established comprehensive testing strategies and quality frameworks for high-stakes, regulated environments. At Avant Mutual, I served as QA Lead guiding a cross-functional team through a major platform migration from a legacy LAMP stack to a cloud-native .NET and React architecture. In this capacity, I directed release cycles, enforced strict quality gates, ran daily defect triage sessions across engineering and business stakeholders, and led data integrity validation. Similarly, at Wpay (Woolworths Group), I defined end-to-end quality architecture across distributed payment systems, formulated robust test strategies to validate critical message structures and failure modes prior to rollout, and operated in a dual BA/QA capacity to align technical design specifications with business requirements.

My technical background bridges strategic test governance, data assurance, and modern automation. I bring strong hands-on capabilities in SQL for data validation, REST API and API Gateway regression testing, and CI/CD integration using Azure DevOps pipelines. Furthermore, I have integrated security checks via Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) into build pipelines, delivered end-to-end automation suites using Playwright, and utilized Jira and Zephyr to ensure complete traceability from user stories to acceptance evidence. Whether coordinating defect resolution, mitigating cross-system integration risks, or coaching delivery contributors, my focus remains on delivering reliable, secure, and fully auditable platforms.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my quality leadership, payment and financial system domain experience, and risk-based testing methodologies will contribute to the success of this platform implementation. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,  

**Anoop Sinkaran**
